backlog.title: Add ac --version so bug reports can state a version
backlog.note: README tells testers to cat ~/.astro/code/version; a flag is the obvious place to look

backlog.title: A plugin surface for adopters with vertical requirements — undecided whether we want one
backlog.note: Canon is already the plugin system for behaviour — every agent is told to obey CONVENTIONS.md — and Claude Code reads .claude/commands per repo, so domain rules and extra commands cost nothing today. Genuinely closed: the ac verb switch, the loop's role list, and any way to share either. Open question is which tier is worth it, not how to build one.

backlog.title: ac install leaves stale command symlinks in config dirs it no longer targets
backlog.note: ~/.claude/commands still holds 17 links from July, missing every command added since. Harmless but it reads like a real install and misleads anyone debugging a missing command.

backlog.title: Opus 5.5 works untouched, but three places still name old model versions
backlog.note: Verified against the live model docs: astro-code needs no change to use claude-opus-5-5. Roles resolve to the tiers 'opus'/'sonnet' and the harness picks the model, and modelLimit defaults unknown ids to 1M — which is right for opus-5-5 and fable-5-1. What is stale is cosmetic: ARCHITECTURE.md says the session model is Opus 4.8, and ac statusline preview fakes a claude-opus-4-8 payload. Worth a sweep when something else touches those files.
